personality_one_liner: A highly readable, stress-free utility interface designed for quick roadside action and garage maintenance.

spacing.rule: Ensure ample spacing (md to lg) between actionable items to reduce accidental taps during emergency roadside usage. Maintain tight grouping for related motorcycle specs.

do's: Use frosted glass overlay on the sticky bottom action buttons.
Use blur on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls beneath.
Apply glass effects to the AI Chat floating Voice recording overlay.
dont's: Do not use blur on input fields, maintenance log cards, or anywhere it might reduce high-contrast readability.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Secure email/password entry with minimal distraction.

states.error: Inline red validation text below inputs.

screens.layout: Vertical stack with top-aligned logo/hero image, generous lg padding. Inputs use surfaceTertiary with border thickness 1. Primary CTA sticky at bottom above keyboard.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Glanceable dashboard showing active motorcycle status and quick access to critical roadside tools.

states.loading: Skeleton of the motorcycle profile card and 4 action tiles.
states.empty: Prompt to add a motorcycle profile.
states.error: Card indicating offline status with cached data visible.

screens.layout: Top sticky header with offline/online indicator. Hero card displaying the motorcycle (image + Make/Model/Odometer). Below, a 2-column grid for 'Diagnose' and 'Repair Guides', and full-width list items for 'Maintenance Log' and 'AI Chat'.

screens.name: Diagnostics Flow
screens.purpose: A step-by-step Q&A wizard to identify roadside issues quickly.

states.error: Error dialog with 'Retry' CTA if online AI fails (fallback to offline rules).

screens.layout: Progress bar at top. One question per screen (large typography), oversized touch targets (cards) for answers. 'Next'/'Skip' buttons sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Repair Guides
screens.purpose: Offline library of step-by-step mechanical fixes.
screens.layout: Search bar at top. Drill-down list using list items (minimum 56pt height). Detail page uses sticky header (glass) and numbered steps with safety warnings in muted/warning banners.

screens.name: Maintenance Log
screens.purpose: Chronological history of repairs with a quick-entry form.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'Log your first service' CTA.

screens.layout: Sectioned list by year/month. FAB for 'Add Service'. Add Service sheet is a single-column form (KeyboardAvoidingView) using numeric keyboards for odometer/cost. Sticky Save button.

screens.name: AI Chat
screens.purpose: Conversational assistant for complex or specific queries with voice capabilities.

states.empty: Welcome message with suggested prompts (e.g., 'What does this engine noise mean?').
states.error: Offline indicator with disabled input or cached responses.

screens.layout: Standard chat interface. Messages use surfaceSecondary (user) and surfaceTertiary (AI). Each AI message includes a subtle TTS 'Speak' icon. Bottom input bar features a prominent Voice Record button (mic icon) that expands/pulses when active.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize extreme readability. This app will be used in harsh lighting conditions (bright sun on the roadside, or dark garage).
Utilize large tap targets (minimum 44x44pt, preferably 56pt) for all lists and core actions (Diagnose, Repair) to accommodate gloved or dirty hands.

Implement the 'Offline-First' architecture visibly. Show a subtle 'Offline Mode' indicator in the Home header when disconnected. Disable only AI Chat if no local model is available, but keep Guides and Diagnostics fully functional.
For the AI Chat, integrate a clear UI state for Voice Input (expanding mic button) and a TTS output button on every Claude response.
Use Phosphor icons (filled for active tabs/states, regular for inactive) to maintain a clean, technical iOS aesthetic.
All forms (Add Maintenance, Auth) must use KeyboardAvoidingView and feature a sticky primary CTA at the bottom.
Ensure 'Ochre/Amber' (brand color) is used sparingly for primary actions, warnings, and highlighting critical components to provide a technical, automotive utility feel.
theme_note: Black & red dark theme is the default; light (white & red) variant toggleable in More > Appearance.
